The open-front wrap silhouette features a shawl/crossover collar with ribbed knit detailing, long sleeves with ribbed cuffs, and a ribbed hem band — all of which retain their shape well with no significant stretching or distortion. The garment earns a Very Good grade because it shows clear signs of prior wear without any major damage: light surface pilling is visible across the front and back body panels (typical of cashmere use), and minor loose threads are present at the bottom hem edge and the brand label. Color is even and consistent throughout with no notable fading or staining, and the fabric structure is fully intact with no holes or tears. Functional elements cannot be fully assessed from the images, but no closures or hardware issues were observed. Overall, this is a presentable, wearable cashmere piece that would benefit from a light de-pilling treatment before use.

buyer_writeup: This is a pair of Vuori women's jogger-style sweatpants in a heathered sage/teal-green colorway, size M, constructed from a recycled polyester-elastane blend with a soft, stretchy hand. The garment features an elasticized waistband with a woven flat drawstring finished with metal aglets, side slash pockets at the hip, flatlock or serged side seam construction, and ribbed cuffs at the ankle for a tapered jogger silhouette. Across seven images covering the front, back, label, detail, and measurement views, the fabric surface shows no visible pilling, staining, abrasion, thinning, or fading — color is consistent and even throughout. All seams appear tight and intact, the waistband elastic retains its structure and gathers evenly, and the drawstring and aglets are present and undamaged. The only cosmetic note is ordinary storage wrinkles that will resolve with a wash or steam. This garment earns an Excellent grade because it shows minimal signs of use with no functional or structural defects detected across any image.
